formats.name: What's under a famous landmark
formats.emotion: 'wait, THAT is under there?' then the urge to rewatch the dive
formats.hook: Frame 1: the landmark above ground, named on screen and in the first spoken sentence, which asks what is under it; the depth meter at 0; the first dive starts by 2.5 s
formats.beats: the landmark, the question -> dive to layer 1 on its word (sign with depth) -> layer 2 -> layer 3 -> the secret or strange layer (stamp) -> the deepest point, the camera pulls back to show the whole stack, the payoff figure on a thing -> ride back up into frame 1 (loop line)

formats.name: How deep the trains really go: a famous station or metro
formats.emotion: surprise at how deep ordinary commuters go every day
formats.hook: Frame 1: the station entrance at street level, named; the question; the first train level by 2.5 s
formats.beats: entrance and question -> each line's level on its word, a train running through, its sign with depth -> the deepest platform, pull-back -> the escalator or lift time as the payoff -> ride up (loop)

formats.name: What holds it up: under a tower, dam, bridge or stadium
formats.emotion: awe at the hidden size of what keeps a giant standing
formats.hook: Frame 1: the structure, named; the question what holds it up; the first layer by 2.5 s
formats.beats: the structure and question -> basement levels -> the raft or caps -> the piles or caissons down to their depth -> bedrock or the water table, pull-back -> the payoff (how deep vs how tall, or the concrete) -> ride up (loop)
